scripts.dev: pnpm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --local --port 8787
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply neverlight-local --local --config wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply neverlight-preview --local --env preview --config wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/preview-state
scripts.dev:preview: pnpm run db:migrate:preview && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --env preview --local --persist-to .wrangler/preview-state --port 8788
